name: The Library of Whispering Tomes
description: An infinite library where books flutter their pages autonomously, whispering ancient secrets to visitors, with floating staircases and glowing manuscripts suspended in mid-air.
prompt: An ethereal library with endless rows of books whose pages flutter mysteriously, glowing manuscripts floating in air, spiral staircases leading into mist, warm amber lighting from ornate chandeliers, mystical atmosphere, hyperrealistic, detailed architecture
caption: Every book here has a story to tell... if you listen closely enough. 📚 What secret would you uncover?
